rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight attainments
conjunction adding to the preceding list
sandhi fusion of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulam; compound expressing attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: What status do the eight attainments of siddhi hold within the root Kaula teaching?
premises: The eight are explicitly named in this context.
The attainment of siddhis is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed directly to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The eight attainments of siddhi constitute the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal compound analysis of siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is compressed by sandhi.
items.plain_english: And the eight, O fair-faced one, along with the attainment of siddhis, are the root Kaula.
